main_text.p: neratio & corruptio, idé esse mutari & mutatum esse, proindeque quod dicitur, ante factum esse, est fieri, restringendum esse ad mutationes quæ fiunt in tempore, non quæ fiunt in instanti individuo, seu momento. Tertiò distinguunt sic: Generatio poteft fumi vel pro sola formæ substantialis productione, & sic fit in nō tempore seu instanti: vel pro productione ista simul cum antegressa materiæ præparatione ac dispositione, & sic fit in tempore. Secundò potest considerari generatio: vel ratione formæ, & sic fit tota simul, & in non tempore seu momento: vel ratione subjecti, & sic fit successive & in tempore. Hactenus solutiones reales.
Personalis solutio esset, si diceres: Tu manifesta impugnas, similis prorsus dicenti: Nil intra est oleam, nil extra est in nucę duri, lucem dicis esse tenebras, purus putus sophista;
Adversus solem ne loquitor: Philosophum non decent hæ inanes argutiæ, hæ inutiles cavillationes.

page.notes: The first word "neratio" is a fragment: the scan begins mid-word, so it is kept as printed. The page's ornament below the text and the large "QUÆ-" at the foot are printed; the ornament is not transcribed. "nucę" is a doubtful reading of the cedilla form. The page number is printed in an old form that reads as 118.
